items.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011
items.q: varying from Jimi Hendrix to Michael Jackson to Cannonball to Mozart

ctx.x: Do you have a fairly extensive CD collection?

Yeah, they’re all in my iPod right now. But yeah, I have somewhere around nine thousand songs in my iPod, varying from Jimi Hendrix to Michael Jackson to Cannonball to Mozart. So it’s an all-around situation.
